caption: The video captures a fixed night landscape: pale rocks and grass at lower left, a dark calm lake in the center and right, and a jagged mountain on the right. The star-filled sky shows an amber-to-orange upper glow, a bright whitish-yellow horizon on the left, and cooler blue-grey air on the right. The terrain remains in frame while the sky changes, with stars scattered against the stationary mountains. A yellow-green aurora-like arc near the left horizon brightens and extends diagonally upward, becoming most defined before the glow broadens. That arc then broadens into a softer diffuse glow, while the low horizon brightness continues fluctuating. The upper sky deepens toward brown, and a faint pink tint appears above the right ridge later. A thin vertical streak briefly appears in the upper-left-center sky before vanishing, leaving the landscape unchanged.
